title: Nuclear Astrophysics
description: Stars fuse by tunnelling: their protons are far too cold to touch, but quantum mechanics lets a few through the Coulomb barrier. The Gamow energy sets which ones.

puzzle.goal: Two nuclei of charges Z and z tunnel through their Coulomb barrier with an energy scale set by their reduced mass m, the speed of light c and the fine-structure constant α. Write that energy E.
puzzle.name: Gamow energy
puzzle.ask: Find E in keV (k = @{k} J) for two protons: m = @{m} kg, c = 2.998e8 m/s, a = @{a}, Z = @{Z}, z = @{z}.
puzzle.method: The tunnelling probability goes as e^(−√(E_G/E)); E_G collects every constant in the WKB exponent.
